messages:
Amy: Quick sync — final copy sprint for Monday's deploy. I put together a tiny hitlist of snippets we need in the internal note + who owns each line.
Devin: send the list pls, I can take rollback owner and the evacuation lane docs.
Amy: here: 1) TL;DR (one sentence) — Lisa 2) What changes (surface-level bullets) — Sara 3) Pinning + version numbers — Jonathan 4) Rollback criteria & owners — Devin 5) Standby rota + pager handoff — Mike 6) Post-deploy smoke checklist — Amy 7) Links to staging runs and perf graphs — Lisa
Lisa: got it. I'll draft TL;DR and add the screenshots.
Sara: I'll keep bullets high-level. Note: call out the config change to routing-mux (no customer-facing API changes).
Jonathan: For pinning — we should pin service image: infra/api:2.17.0 and model bundle: rwd-models/quant-v2.1. Pinning window is until 2.18 lands. OK?
Devin: sounds good. For rollback criteria, propose: 1) 5m sustained error rate >2% OR 2) 3x baseline 95th latency for more than 5m OR 3) regression in key eval set compared to canary. If any trigger, rollback to infra/api:2.16.5 + model bundle rwd-models/quant-v2.0.
Mike: I'll be standby from T-15 to T+60. @Devin can you be primary rollback exec? I'll be secondary.
Devin: yep I can be primary. I'll keep the rollback playbook link pinned.
ops-bot: Reminder — change window requested: Mon 2026-03-23 16:00-18:00 UTC. No other high-risk deploys in that window.
Amy: that window works. We'll do a staged rollout: 10% -> 40% -> 100% with 15m observation between steps. Can we wire deploybot to auto-halt on the metric thresholds we listed?
deploybot: deploy scheduled. Automated halt configured for alerts: error_rate_5m > 2% OR latency_p95 > baseline*3. Canary tag: canary-20260323-1.
Jonathan: I'll update the release-note draft with the version pins and the rollforward/rollback table.
Lisa: adding perf + screenshot links now. One ask: add a short note for Support about expected user-visible footprint (none) and who to page.
Amy: good catch. @Mike can you add the support snippet?
Mike: done — "No user-facing UI changes expected. If you see API 503s, page #oncall and call Devin."
Sara: final question — do we include the compliance checklist for private deployments? Might be relevant for a couple of enterprise customers.
Amy: include a short note linking to private-deploy/2026-03-privacy-checklist. Legal already signed off.
Devin: last ops item — who will post the internal announce? I'd prefer to post the short RN in #eng-releases and email ops/sales a 1-paragraph.
Amy: I'll post the stitch in #eng-releases (snippet + links) and draft the one-paragraph email for ops/sales. Jonathan, can you review the final RN before I post?
Jonathan: will review by T-2 hours.
Lisa: timeline check — staging smoke run scheduled for Sun 22:00 UTC. Please run the canary eval after that and tag results.
Amy: everyone, please ack this thread if you have your items. We'll do a 10m standup at T-30.
Devin: ack — rollback playbook link is current.
Sara: ack — bullets in progress.
Lisa: ack — screenshots uploading.
Mike: ack — standby rota updated.
Jonathan: ack — version pins ready to merge.
Amy: thanks all. I'll post the internal snippet once Jonathan thumbs up and ops-bot confirms the deploy window remains reserved. :thumbsup:
